summary: Iteration 3 covers new features: Property Polygon (draw/upload/clear/cancel), Report Sharing (?report=<id>), Print-ready Property Brief overlay, and Traffic layer (disabled TomTom). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in ~21s including 4 new tests (POST/GET /api/reports + 404, /api/traffic/config disabled, tile 404 when disabled, tile 400 on invalid coords). Frontend e2e: Draw flow works — after 4 map clicks draw-hint shows '4 placed', property-area shows '4 pts · 535.32 ha', distance-mode changes to 'Distances from property line'. Share button updates URL to /?report=pnatEP9o. Print brief overlay renders with report-title 'Property Brief', print-now-button visible, close-report-button hides overlay. Traffic toggle under 'Urban' group is present; toggling it shows layer-warning-traffic with correct copy: 'Live traffic needs a TomTom key — set TOMTOM_API_KEY on the backend.' Clear-property reverts distance-mode to 'Distances from center point' and removes property-area. Cancel-draw exits drawing without setting property. Shared URL in new tab restores property-area and radius-value '1.50 km'. print-report-button correctly disabled before pin/property is set. Regression: search + result click and custom-upload modal opens; drop-pin toggles pin-drop mode.

integration_issues.flow: POI list after draw / after drop-pin at default map center
integration_issues.issue: poi-distance-item count observed as 0 in this run after drawing a very large 535 ha polygon and after a plain drop-pin without prior search; whereas the search→result-0→Times Square flow reliably produces POIs (verified iter 2). Suspected: polygon centroid lands over water or coordinate falls outside curated NYC static bounds plus synthetic fallback threshold, OR fetch race after property set. Non-blocking — search-based flow works.

action_items: Investigate why POI list can be empty after finish-draw (large polygon) and after drop-pin at map default view; if the POI fetch key uses the property centroid/pin lat-lon, ensure fetchPOIs is invoked and that curated+synthetic fallback triggers for any coordinate (backend fallback already always returns >0 — check frontend request formation and race conditions around property state).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Report.id uses secrets.token_urlsafe(6) — ~8 char id; collision probability very low but no uniqueness check on insert. Acceptable for MVP.
server.py in-memory _POI_CACHE has no TTL; if traffic/report modules grow, extract per-domain modules from server.py (~380 lines).

Traffic tile route: 502 errors from upstream not cached/rate-limited; a burst of tile requests could hammer TomTom or overload backend when key is set. Consider ETag/If-None-Match or edge caching once enabled.

MapWorkstation.jsx: after property is drawn, POI fetch may reference a stale center; verify AbortController usage and that dependency array in the effect includes property polygon centroid (see suspected empty POI list on large polygons).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% of tested flows — all new-feature checks pass; only POI list empty for one edge case

seed_data_creation: Created one report (id=pnatEP9o) in Mongo via /api/reports for share flow; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints /api/reports (POST/GET) and /api/traffic/{config,tiles/z/x/y.png} are verified. TomTom key intentionally absent → tiles disabled with 404 by design. Frontend selectors used: draw-property-button, draw-hint, finish-draw-button, cancel-draw-button, clear-property-button, property-file-input, property-area, distance-mode, share-report-button, print-report-button, print-report, report-title, report-total, print-now-button, close-report-button, layer-toggle-traffic (inside 'Urban' collapsed group — click button:has-text('Urban') to expand), layer-warning-traffic. Use .leaflet-container (not [data-testid=map-container] — React-Leaflet MapContainer does not forward data-testid) for map click coords. Grant clipboard permissions before share test to see 'Share link copied'; else fallback 'Share link ready' toast is expected.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical failures. Minor POI-empty edge case may be a race between property setting and POI fetch, or centroid over water; needs source-level inspection of MapWorkstation.jsx effects.
